name: Doom Brutalist Community Project
summary:
Rejoice! Lovers of All Things Grey!

Welcome to D.B.C.P. or the Doom Brutalist Community Project, inspired by the Quake community's Quake Brutalist Jam! It is a community project where we seek to bring brutalism to the colorful world of good o' Doom. Venture through twenty-eight maps of different mapper's interpretation of brutalism and their implementation in Doom, whether it is a grey desolate mega structure, an aftermath of socialist brutalism, or an abandoned cement city which has become mother-nature's lush garden.
